title: AI Market Signed Receipt
description: Payment receipt for a capability invocation

price_usd.description: In the v1 canonical, the exact JSON number token. 0.0 and 0 are different signed bytes (§7.3.3).

latency_ms.description: In the v1 canonical, the exact JSON number token. Absent serializes as 0 (§7.3.3).

success.description: Canonical bit is 1 or 0. Absent serializes as 0 (§7.3.3).

type.description: Present on a v2 receipt. A rejection uses "rejection".

category.description: v2 digest key (§7.3.4). Absent is JSON null inside the digest, not an omitted key.

plugin.description: v2 digest key (§7.3.4). Absent is JSON null inside the digest, not an omitted key.

verification.description: Pay-on-Verified envelope (unsigned receipt field; the envelope carries its own ed25519 signature once resolved)

public_key.description: Claim, not an identity. Verifiers use a pinned key (§7.3.1).

version.description: JSON integer 2 when the signature covers the v2 canonical. Omitted means v1 (§7.3.1).
